# reconcile backlog processing with watermark

Processes multiple merged PRs in merge-time order even if they are provided out-of-order by the forge, and advances a watermark so subsequent reconcile runs do nothing. This supports ordered, repeatable incremental updates.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_incremental.py` — `tests.test_incremental.test_reconcile_processes_backlog_in_order_and_is_idempotent`
